message.content:
The median (i.e., the middle value) of all residential home sales in California is roughly **$800 000** as of the most recent full‑year data (2023‑2024).  
- **Source:** Zillow Research – “California Home Value Index” (latest update 2024‑02).  
- **Note:** The median is often used as a proxy for the “average” price because it is less skewed by extremely high‑priced luxury homes than a simple arithmetic mean.
